description: The context budget for this repo, read by scripts/check-load.mjs. Every value comes in one pair: `*_ideal_bytes` is the convergence target and never fails, `*_cap_bytes` is the hard ceiling and does. Exceeding an ideal is debt a later pass pays down; exceeding a cap is a finding. The gap between the two is deliberate: a cap set at the ideal would fail on the day it was written, and a cap with no ideal has no direction. A path may add its own `cap` to override scope_fan_in_cap_bytes.

representative_paths.why: the heaviest common edit: a feature component under a feature glob
the largest real page, nested under a learn route: catches the page globs and the learn-layout ones
a story, the widest fan-in of any single edit
a backend service: the control case, essentially the always-on layer
the cheapest edit in the repo
